title: Release Visuals — Spotlighted Side-by-Side Before/After Flows & Inline Overlay Annotations for Changelog
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Produce a focused asset set for the v2026.03 changelog and release blog that highlights UX improvements to the onboarding / quickstart flows. Deliverables: (1) two side-by-side before/after full-viewport screenshots for the Quickstart wizard with pixel-perfect alignment and copy-accurate overlays, (2) three modular spotlight overlays that call out micro-interactions (keyboard shortcut hint, streaming token indicator, new step validator), and (3) an annotated PNG and an SVG source for each asset so marketing and docs can localize without re-rendering. This ticket covers design comps, asset export rules, and final handoff with a CSS snippet for lightweight in-blog overlays.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Side-by-side PNGs (1920x1080) showing before vs after with consistent baseline guides; 2) Spotlight overlays exported as both transparent PNG and SVG; 3) All copy matches the latest PRD (link in references); 4) Assets uploaded to marketing drive and linked in doc; 5) Design check-in and sign-off from PM and Engineering; 6) Lightweight CSS snippet included for blog embedding and docs usage.
tasks: Audit current Quickstart screenshots and capture fresh frames from staging at 1200ms and 2000ms to show streaming tokens
Create baseline grid and component masks to ensure perfect side-by-side alignment
Design three spotlight overlays (tip, keyboard CTA, validator) with accessible color contrast
Produce SVG masters and export versioned PNGs (2x and 3x) per asset naming convention
Write export notes and CSS snippet for marketing/docs embedding
Upload final assets to shared drive and add links to the changelog PR
